_help: Rules turn a customer's risk level and main risk-raising factors into suggested actions. Fields: id (unique), action (text shown), risk_levels (Low/Medium/High), driver (feature that must be among the customer's top risk-raising factors), conditions ([{feature, op, value}]; op is one of < <= > >= == != in), priority (higher first). Feature names must match the data columns. Thresholds below are the 20%/80% cut points of train.csv (churn rises steadily across them). The actions are business judgement, not proven by this data.

rules.action: Proactive customer-support outreach: contact the customer before they raise another ticket.
Offer a personalised discount or a better-value plan.
Early-tenure retention: onboarding follow-up and a loyalty benefit.
Re-engagement campaign with personalised content recommendations.
Suggest longer-form series and curated watch lists to build viewing habit.
